description: Address variants for the AI evals (S4b-BL-225, docs/ai/ai-design.md 8.3b). Each set changes ONLY the address-like text of the golden set's fixture houses (address, street, locality, label, and notes by appending) and, where a case names a place a set changed, that case's question or pasted text and its expected locality or mustContain. Ids, coordinates, status, price, bedrooms, rating, checklist, contact fields and visits are never touched. The golden set itself (docs/ai/evals/golden-set.json) is not changed by this file; AddressVariants.apply (Java: backend/src/test/java/app/doorprints/server/ai/eval, TypeScript: web/src/app/core/ai/address-variants.ts) builds the varied copy a run uses.

changes.change: First version (S4b-BL-225): eight sets (known, known-alt, unknown-invented, landmark-pin, vernacular, vernacular-strict, messy, hostile), all 30 fixture houses in every set except known; case rewrites where a set changes a place a case names; fingerprints of every applied set, recomputed by the Java and the Vitest tests.

known.description: The golden set as it is: the fixture houses and cases unchanged. Same as the default run; kept as a named set so the workflow can say so.

Cases that named a changed place are rewritten to the new one.
